<!-- ce-merge:demo-noop -->
**DEMO ONLY: version CI uses no-op steps. No builds, MTR or unit tests will execute for this integration demo.**

Demonstrate the real user flow on RidhaOracle/mysql-server: collaborator approval → maintainer `/integrate` → Git conflict/ancestry preparation → parallel no-op version checks → native sequential PR merges.

This unchanged source commit adds an inert three-line public fixture, `mysql-test/std_data/ce_merge_rehearsal.txt`, to 9.7. Its existing collaborator approval and earlier real source CI are retained. The current demo simulates the missing version CI; green DEMO jobs are not evidence that tests ran.

The bot must squash this source PR into the fork’s 9.7, then create a PR from the real 9.7 branch into the fork’s trunk and merge it normally. The actual squash commit must remain in trunk’s history. 8.4 stays unchanged. No temporary integration branches are used.

Requires trusted OCA verification and current-head approval from a Write collaborator. Wait for readiness, then post a fresh `/integrate`. Do not merge manually. All targets are in RidhaOracle/mysql-server, not the original repository.
